verdict.rationale: Belvo's Smart Collections lets users set balance conditions and collection amounts. Belvo then watches the account in the background and notifies them when the condition is met (belvo-docs-24, belvo-docs-4), with event delivery via registrable webhooks (belvo-docs-25, belvo-docs-26). This is a narrow, product-specific condition→trigger mechanism rather than a general rules engine, and the triggered 'action' is a notification rather than a configurable automated action. Missing for 10: a general-purpose user-defined rules/automation engine, configurable actions beyond notifications, rule triggers across arbitrary event types, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
